messages.subject: Download different Documents
parts:
Hello everybody!

I am a new user of RStudio and Shiny, I am using them from some weeks ago. At this moment I have an application that allows the user selects different values of Input Controls. Using these values the app generates a document "csv" that can be download using the downloadHandler function on the Server side, and either downloadButton or downloadLink in the Ui side.

My problem is that the app can be executed many times (for different Input Control values) and every time it´s executed a new document is generated. However, when a new file is created, just this file is possible to be download from the "Download Bottom" and the previous generated documents are not accesible. I can save all documents in a folder on the machine where the Shiny is installed, but this app is for users that must be able to get all documents that they generated form the Shiny View.

Any of you has make this before? Do you know if it is possible?

Thank you in advance!

Regards.

Marta
